written.headline: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO after intervention by Trump and tech allies
written.summary: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO less than two weeks after his resignation, following lobbying by President Donald Trump and Silicon Valley allies. The reversal occurred while Nvidia faces federal investigations and congressional scrutiny over governance and personal connections to a suspected Chinese spy.

written.headline: EU plans €50B fund for European AI and quantum companies
written.summary: The European Union plans to mobilize up to €50 billion for a Sovereign Tech Equity Fund. The fund will make long-term, high-risk bets on European artificial intelligence and quantum computing companies to bolster technological independence.

written.headline: US intelligence briefed congressional aides on Alice Huang affair
written.summary: US intelligence officials informed congressional aides that Alice Huang was not directed by China's MSS regarding the Jensen Huang affair, though she may have passed intelligence to the MSS. The briefing followed statements by President Trump that Jensen Huang was not a security threat.

written.headline: Asian tech stocks tumble following US tech sell-off
written.summary: Asian technology stocks fell sharply on Wednesday, led by steep losses in Japanese semiconductor stocks and major regional chipmakers following a US tech sell-off. Advantest dropped over 12%, Tokyo Electron fell more than 7%, and Samsung and SK Hynix declined by over 6%.

written.headline: Goldman Sachs flags 2028 risks for memory chip companies amid AI spending concerns
written.summary: Goldman Sachs warned that a potential slowdown in artificial intelligence infrastructure investments could create risks for memory chip companies in 2028. The bank estimates that memory will account for roughly 40 percent of hyperscaler capital expenditure in 2028, down from about 44 percent in 2027.

written.headline: AidenAI raises $32M Series A to expand enterprise AI platform
written.summary: Enterprise AI startup AidenAI raised a $32 million Series A funding round led by A91 Partners. The company plans to use the funds to expand its AI builder platform and develop industry-specific AI solutions.
